summary: IAMGOLD Corporation filed a Form 6-K on April 27, 2026, reporting the publication of its 2025 Annual Sustainability Report. The filing consists of a news release highlighting progress on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) practices, guided by GRI, SASB, and TCFD standards. No transaction, material corporate event, or special situation—such as an acquisition, divestiture, management change, or capital return—is announced. This is a routine non-financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
